scope: Entire combined transaction, quarantine, publication identity and trusted restore implementation
MixedField root/response atomicity and backend shallow trial commit premise
Full/compact/debug-replay recording and survivor checkpoint isolation
R1 and R2 remediation, normal-path parity evidence and limited D2/D7 correspondence

prior_findings.reason: Accepted NumPy integer counters are converted to Python int before retained metadata and arithmetic. Signed/unsigned success, parity, serialization, checkpoint/restore and failure regressions pass.
Versioned configuration binding includes calibration, clock, effective cadence, RC/hysteresis degrees and width; stable identity and distinguishing cross-configuration restore regression pass.

advance no longer retains first before its type check. Rejected noninteger input cannot poison failure_index. Quarantine now names advance or restore, and restore input_first is always null. Regression covers np.float32, object, string and NumPy bool rejection followed by an injected trusted native-query restore failure, JSON serialization and valid recovery.

reasoning: MixedField stages response rows, carried state, count and normalizer, computes/sign-normalizes a new QR root and checks finiteness before assigning its four mutable fields. No old root/state array is modified by the staging path. rows remains a deliberately response-only API, not a likelihood transaction.

Backend flush updates a shallow trial and verifies exact count and live response equality plus root/normalizer finiteness before committing. Inspection confirms current H5 and H7 updates replace mutable arrays and read shared immutable calibration/projection data. Native and objective retain the original field object, whose attributes are replaced at commit.

Admission rejects unsupported input before numerical mutation. After admission the guarded transition catches synchronous Exception failures and disables current access first. It reads native.count to distinguish actual consumed evidence from stale Python live_count and carrier publication; failure to obtain count leaves it unknown. A consumed block cannot be retried through the quarantined API.

Publication stages shape/finiteness/counter validation and a complete carrier before copying. Post-publication exceptions still quarantine, including equal consumed/published prefix cases. Current readout, full_message, advance and checkpoints refuse quarantine. Diagnostic copies remain explicitly labeled and do not alias carrier or failure dictionaries.

Status binds source/model/configuration/published prefix and states provisional_local_precision with authorization unresolved. Earlier copied publications apply only to their named prefix; no continuing physical validity or permission to take a proposed load is inferred.

Refresh uses the original public prior and accumulated field, not the outgoing posterior as independent evidence. Recoverable refresh failure restores the native snapshot; escaping update/query/restore failure quarantines. These paths preserve evidence ownership within the stated interface.

Trusted restore checks schema/identity/clock/cadence/counters/shapes/finiteness/chronology, then requires exact restored native-query carrier and anchor reproduction before clearing quarantine. Outer compact restore checks saved file/runtime/source/binary bindings, constructs fresh objects and returns them only after validation. Coherent tampering and standalone untrusted-array restore remain excluded.

Compact checkpoints serialize only active aligned arms. Full, compact and replay exits save explicit diagnostic messages. Real-entry-point tests show failed H7 consumed32/published16, survivor completion to9000 and byte-exact survivor replay, with quarantined H7 absent from resumable payload. Recording parity removes only source_id after checking each source association.

Parity harness uses verified pre-repair backend/MixedField files with shared unchanged Native/Compressed dependencies, identical ordered observations and public prior. Current source identities and pinned baseline git-show identities independently match. Three finite controls cover14720 observations,921 advances,13 scheduled refreshes and one partial overflow, with byte-equal checked numerical state and carrier. New status metadata is intentionally excluded.

D2/D7 acceptance is limited to implementation correspondence for single-owner synchronous containment and unresolved authorization. No validated physical enclosure or bounded autonomous recovery premise is discharged. Extra dense root storage and unbounded-by-this-review process workspace are explicitly disclosed.

limits: Acceptance applies only to the exact reviewed source hashes and declared single-owner synchronous Python Exception model. Finite fault injections do not prove every runtime path.
Private ctypes/NumPy mutation, mutable public configuration, concurrent readers, asynchronous interruption, process/native crashes, power loss and arbitrary coherent corruption are outside scope.

MemoryError disables reads first; allocation of diagnostics is not guaranteed. Campaign handlers catch selected exception classes, so arbitrary quarantining exceptions are not all guaranteed to produce completed result artifacts.

Restore integrity checks are identity checks on trusted local checkpoints, not authentication or exhaustive consistency proofs for arbitrary finite tampering. Older prefixes require once-only replay of missing ordered observations.
No physical uncertainty coverage, useful query authorization, silent-bias detection, aging/lifetime assurance, autonomous recovery deadline or resource/timing qualification.
H7 packed root remains50624 bytes and a trial dense root adds100352 bytes before other workspace; this is not firmware-ready or an M23 SRAM certificate.
Parity and71-test parent receipts were inspected and hash-checked; reviewer independently reran47 targeted tests, not the parity suite or long campaigns.
